name: Vellune
scope: Three new core page concepts, desktop and continuous mobile; image-only raster mockups.
density_note: Exact native desktop dimensions and final mobile dimensions are recorded below. Desktop is not claimed as 2× at 1440 px. Mobile assembly only proportionally downscales wider parts; no upscaling. Controls and spacing are visual mockups, not measured responsive CSS or working UI.
palette: Light copper #EED4C6 and pale shell #F7E6DC with a small warm-white #FCF7F1 pause; cacao #3E2923 ink. Visible gentle color, never a beige wash.
fonts_art_direction: Bodoni Moda 400/500 for spaced VELLUNE wordmark and elegant display, DM Sans 400/500 for all UI/body.
facts: Crescent $460: oxblood gathered crescent shoulder bag with brass rings, one leather shoulder strap, no flap. Column $520: upright cognac CYLINDER tote, not rectangular, with long double handles. Sillage $380: small soft ivory drawstring pouch.

references.observed: Product gallery, product identity and selection controls are separated from secondary material/care information; live text revisited 25 October, retained WDA visual/mobile captures consulted.
references.decision: Keep purchasing legible while changing object scale and editorial rhythm. Do not copy Polene products or claims.

references.observed: Retained WDA capture shows tools/material photographs and concise captions.
references.decision: Atelier uses three material studies and restrained copy rather than a row of service cards.

qa.desktop: Complete collection header/footer; correctly shaped three products with $460/$520/$380 labels; gallery varies scale without enclosing cards.
qa.mobile: Full upper/lower and final joined image inspected; single-column product sequence, generous product imagery, no clipped bag or footer. Native-width alignment uses proportional downscale only.
qa.density: Final 776 px supports 2× at388 CSS px, or1.99× at390; no upscale.
